archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST mixed with ARCHETYPE 5 (Tech/Data Vibe)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for main layout sections, flat solid surfaces with 1px border-white/10 for cards. Soft hover lift.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle noise overlay on the background. Use Tracing Beam effect for the '3 Published Research Papers' highlight card.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Primary button uses Cyan with a subtle glow. Interaction animations required.

layouts.hero: Asymmetric layout. Left-aligned heavy typography. Right side features a subtle 3D element or particle network. Massive padding (py-32).
layouts.skills: Bento Grid (High Density). Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
layouts.projects: Grid Layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). Cards with 1px border, dark background, image on top.
layouts.contact: Two-column layout on desktop: Left side huge 'Let's Talk' text, Right side Shadcn form.

libraries.visuals: tsparticles (for data network background in hero), react-fast-marquee (for skills ribbon)

hero_background.usage: Use as a low-opacity (opacity-10 to opacity-20) background behind the hero section with a radial mask to fade out edges.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: You have .js/.jsx files, not .tsx files. Follow React/JS syntax.
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, tsparticles, @tsparticles/react, @phosphor-icons/react, react-fast-marquee.
Implement Shadcn UI for form elements (input, textarea, button, form) and use Sonner for contact form submission feedback.
Do NOT use a generic centered layout. Keep headings left-aligned. Use asymmetric margins.
Ensure ALL interactive elements and key informational elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
The hero section should have 'Harshit Goel' as H1 and 'Data Scientist | ML Engineer | Data Analyst' as animated text or subtitle.
Include a 'Download Resume' button in the hero and header. It should have a download functionality.

The projects section should list 5 Power BI dashboards (IPL Analysis, Amazon Prime Video, IMDb, Indian Restaurant Analytics, Superstore) and 3 ML notebooks (Credit Card Fraud Detection, CLV Prediction, Student Performance Prediction). Include download links for .pbix files.
Include an Education timeline and a Certifications & Achievements section highlighting '3 published research papers'.
Contact form must post to the FastAPI backend to store inquiries in MongoDB.
Include social links (LinkedIn, GitHub, email, phone) in the footer or a sticky sidebar.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Apply micro-animations to all interactive elements (hover states, entrance animations).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Do not center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor icons.
Never use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided image URLs.
Do not use complete transparent background in header; use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent dark color.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards.
